      • Industry-Leading Obstacle-Crossing Power: AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 dynamically raises the body to glide over thresholds and uneven floors without losing suction. Effortlessly crosses up to 3.46 in double-layer steps and cleans carpets up to 1.18 in deep, so every room stays fully cleaned, uninterrupted.
      • Ultra-Precise Navigation with Fewer Missed Spots: Powered by StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, advanced 3D ToF sensors and RGB vision build accurate maps in real time. Recognises over 300 obstacles to avoid clutter, reduce interruptions, and deliver smoother routes with more complete coverage.
      • Cleans Under 3.13 in Furniture with Ease: With its ultra-slim design, Saros 20 glides under sofas and beds as low as 3.13 inches, removing hidden dust and pet hair from places you rarely clean. No moving furniture, no missed spots—just a deeper, more effortless clean every day.
      • Extreme 36,000 Pa, Zero Hair Hassle: The 36,000 Pa digital motor pulls dust, pet hair, and debris from deep floor gaps with ease. A dual anti-tangle system automatically handles hair buildup, cutting down manual brush cleaning—perfect for pet owners who want powerful, worry-free results.
      • Fully Automated Dock for True Hands-Free Care: Brand New RockDock features a new one-piece cleaning tray that boosts mop coverage and water capacity for deeper washing and quieter operation. Combined with 100℃ hot water washing, 55℃ hot air drying, self-cleaning maintenance, and up to 65 days of auto dust emptying, it delivers a truly hands-free experience.
      • Edge-to-Edge Cleaning with Smart Reach: FlexiArm technology extends the side brush and mop to reach corners, edges, and under furniture where dirt hides. Mark curtains in the app, and the robot cleans behind them intelligently—leaving no blind spots and no missed messes.
      • AI-Powered App Control: Control everything in the Roborock App, including SmartPlan 3.0, which learns your home and routines to optimize cleaning with one tap. Voice control, smart mapping, and the built-in RGB camera let you check in on your pets anytime, delivering a smarter, more effortless clean for pet-loving homes. (Supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi)
      See more

        Amazing for keeping floors clean with multiple pets.

        Reviewed in Canada on July 30, 2026
        Colour Name: Black-01
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        This purchase has been vastly life changing. I was skeptical that this robot vacuum/mop would be able to handle my filthy floors. If any household is going to put this to the test, it’s my household. We have two giant breed dogs (mastiff and a Pyrenees) that are constantly shedding copious amounts of fur, not to mention the dirt and dust they track in and the drool. I had given up on having clean floors as I could not keep up with daily vacuuming. I was doubtful that the vacuum would have large enough capacity for the amount of fur, but it certainly manages. I am also not very tech savvy, but found the app set-up user friendly and intuitive. I have set the robot to vacuum the entire house every day and additional vacuum and mop 3x per week (I have the empty dustbin feature set to most frequent). It does an amazing job. The internal dust bag seems to last a month before full and the water reservoir requires refilling about once every 2 weeks. There is still plenty of floor cleaner after 1 month of frequent mopping. Anyone else wondering if this can handle a multi pet household, I thoroughly recommend.

        Much cry and little wool

        Reviewed in Canada on December 25, 2025
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I bought this product few months back and while the app and other functionality like mop washing etc. are great but it disappoints where it matters the most which is cleaning

        1. It cannot even vaccum a loose rubber band lying on the floor

        2. We have seen it being unable to suck outer onion peels at times which shouldn’t be a problem at all with all the suction power advertised

        3. If some food item is stuck to the floor it can neither clean nor mop it leaving the stains behind

        I have a roomba i3 which is basic vaccum having lower suction power numbers than Roborock but when it comes to issues reported above roomba does the job way better than fancy Roborock

        So please keep the same in mind while buying this product

        This little guy is awesome! Our business is just under 1500 square feet of tile floors with a few padded mats, and every morning we come in to the place being spotless.

        I am going to be harsh considering the premium price.

        First of all, I had to return my first order after 28 days of daily use. One of the wheel completely seized up for no apparent reason. Fortunately, the support wasnt an hassle and sent a replacement, but thank god this was in the 30 days warranty ?

        Next let's talk features coming from an older premium roomba. This robot is leaps above, make no mistakes. I just wanted a premium robot able to handle pets hair (2 bernese mountain dogs). And I barely, if ever, have to intervene, where I would have to manually do so almost daily with another model. Where a roomba will suicide into every object, this robot is very respectful of the objects in his path, although I find they overtuned the AI detection for dog poop. (I never have dog poop in my house, but it seems to think every chair leg is one...)

        Lastly, I am removing more points for the software. There is seemingly no way to control the robot pressure anymore ? Every answer I find isn't reflected in today's software version. No way to setup permanent "zones" and assign rules or quick routines to them. The remote control feature requires manual authorization on the robot every time, so it serves no purpose if I cant monitor my home when outside. And the mapping is very BAD. My home layout is very simple and traditional but it required heavy manual correction to even remotely make sense of my layout. It couldn't even map simples walls and created fictional spaces between the room. And if you have mirrors, dood luck...

      • Gabe K
        5 out of 5 stars
        Verified Purchase

        A great cleaning experience with technology that works

        Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2026
        Colour Name: Black-01
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        The technology and features of the Saros 20 finally bring everything I need to keep my house clean with minimal effort. Compared to other robot vacuums I have had, it was easy to set up and started cleaning right away.

        I have had robot mops that did a good job in the past, but the Saros 20 has some features that really make a difference. First, the water used to clean the mop gets hotter, so it is more sanitary and the mop heads do not start to smell bad. Also, the mop will reach closer to the wall which finally cleans all of the floor instead of needing to go back and do manual mopping. Also, the mop pads are higher quality and I noticed a cleaner floor after the first mopping.

        The vacuum is also clearly better than anything else I have tried. The suction picked up more dirt and I notice the carpets are cleaner. I didn't need to program or set up anything. The Saros 20 detects the carpets and tiles. It automatically drops the mop pads off when it goes to vacuum, so there is no dragging the mop over the carpoet and it is able to stay close to the carpet to clean even better.

        The navigation is also a big upgrade. The best vacuums I have tried before had rotating lidar on the top. But that made the robot taller and sometimes would fail or need to be cleaned. The Saros 20 has the navigation on the front and sides, so the robot is much shorter, closer to the ground, than others. The new imaging technology is also great at seeing obstacles and understanding where it is going. It does not bump into anything and even knows how to climb over small objects. Amazing! It knows how tall it is and sees the height of furniture. It does not get stuck under things or go places it cannot get out of. The mapping was fast and made a better picture of what the house layout is. I have not used the furniture or curtain features, but it will even keep track of where the furniture is. It even takes pictures of my dog if I ask it to. Fun!

        I was also impressed with how fast it finished cleaning. It spends less time figuring out where to go and just gets the job done. It doesn't waste time re-cleaning areas, backtracking, or trying to free itself from tight spots. It moves from room to room, finishing entire floor faster than my previous robots. It is also quieter than anything else I've seen. The combination of stronger suction, deep mopping, and fast, intelligent navigation makes this a pleasant, frustration-free cleaning experience. I don't think anyone should hesitate. This is how robot vacuums are meant to be.

      About this Item

      • Industry-Leading Obstacle-Crossing Power: AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 dynamically raises the body to glide over thresholds and uneven floors without losing suction. Effortlessly crosses up to 3.46 in double-layer steps and cleans carpets up to 1.18 in deep, so every room stays fully cleaned, uninterrupted.
      • Ultra-Precise Navigation with Fewer Missed Spots: Powered by StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, advanced 3D ToF sensors and RGB vision build accurate maps in real time. Recognises over 300 obstacles to avoid clutter, reduce interruptions, and deliver smoother routes with more complete coverage.
      • Cleans Under 3.13 in Furniture with Ease: With its ultra-slim design, Saros 20 glides under sofas and beds as low as 3.13 inches, removing hidden dust and pet hair from places you rarely clean. No moving furniture, no missed spots—just a deeper, more effortless clean every day.
      • Extreme 36,000 Pa, Zero Hair Hassle: The 36,000 Pa digital motor pulls dust, pet hair, and debris from deep floor gaps with ease. A dual anti-tangle system automatically handles hair buildup, cutting down manual brush cleaning—perfect for pet owners who want powerful, worry-free results.
      • Fully Automated Dock for True Hands-Free Care: Brand New RockDock features a new one-piece cleaning tray that boosts mop coverage and water capacity for deeper washing and quieter operation. Combined with 100℃ hot water washing, 55℃ hot air drying, self-cleaning maintenance, and up to 65 days of auto dust emptying, it delivers a truly hands-free experience.
      • Edge-to-Edge Cleaning with Smart Reach: FlexiArm technology extends the side brush and mop to reach corners, edges, and under furniture where dirt hides. Mark curtains in the app, and the robot cleans behind them intelligently—leaving no blind spots and no missed messes.
      • AI-Powered App Control: Control everything in the Roborock App, including SmartPlan 3.0, which learns your home and routines to optimize cleaning with one tap. Voice control, smart mapping, and the built-in RGB camera let you check in on your pets anytime, delivering a smarter, more effortless clean for pet-loving homes. (Supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi)

      Product description

      Elite Performance, Ultra-Slim Design: The Roborock Saros 20 redefines home cleaning with a record-breaking 36,000 Pa digital motor and a dual anti-tangle system. At only 3.14 inches tall, it effortlessly reaches under low sofas and beds, capturing pet hair and dust in areas other vacuums miss. Next-Gen Intelligence & Navigation: Powered by the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, this robot utilizes 3D ToF and RGB vision to navigate precisely around 300+ obstacles. The AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 allows it to climb double-layer thresholds up to 3.46 inches and clean deep carpets up to 1.18 inches without interruption. Ultimate Hands-Free Maintenance: 212°F Hot Water Wash; 131°F Hot Air Drying; Up to 65 days self-emptying. FlexiArm Technology: Extends mops and side brushes for perfect edge-to-edge cleaning. Smart Control at Your Fingertips: Manage everything via the Roborock App. With SmartPlan 3.0 AI, the Saros 20 learns your routine to optimize schedules automatically. Perfect for pet owners seeking a smarter, deeper clean.
